facts.fact: 派活：Felix 三天内潜入办公室偷 Syphon 书（书就压在文书下，疑为 Syphon Source 本尊）
facts.anchor: “I need you to steal the Syphon book from his office.”

facts.fact: 她的 meticulous 档案一次堵住他全部提问（专业级贼务 vs 平时 wing it）
facts.anchor: They held the answers to all of his questions and many more.

facts.fact: Kronan 拔剑警告 Felix 离公主远点——醋意+职责双重
facts.anchor: “Touch her, and I will cut your body in two,” Kronan warned

facts.fact: Phaedra 委婉用词：听说她「devastating」（屠场）——她努力挑了个不那么负面的词
求守密：Phaedra 请她同样守住 Bloodborne 秘密（她先确认她会守）
facts.anchor: I hope you will guard this secret as well as you have guarded mine.

facts.fact: 秃鹫论：最危险的秃鹫「长得不像秃鹫、装成朋友」——高议会生存指南
Kronan×Phaedra 摊牌：她的肯定句（不是疑问）让公主 sad sigh——「It can never be. It's complicated.」
